answer: Behavioural drift fingerprinting. Each identity’s action vectors are embedded per epoch and compared to its own prior centroid; a sustained sharp deviation triggers review, while a stable signal acts as a beacon confirming continuity. Agents whose histories match no orchard of established behavioural clusters are throttled until they fund a full re-verification sweep. An attacker must maintain consistent cross-epoch behaviour across every sybil, paying the compute and review cost per identity, since a ridge of near-identical new profiles collapses into a single flagged cluster.
